title: Real-valued representation of negation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{\pm1\}$. The real-valued function associated with the pointwise negation of $f$ is the pointwise negative of the real-valued function associated with $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
